Select the first 500 activity measurements for monoamine oxidase B (CHEMBL221). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL221. Join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, and standard_units. Rank rows by potency (standard_value ascending) and limit to 500.
